metric_definition: Equal complete reserved-group mean MAE in physical units; RMSE square root is taken within group, before averaging groups.
independent_unit: whole co-cultured strain including every replicate/time

reference_equations.challenger: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the combined branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.
reference_equations.baseline_constant_selection: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the constant_selection branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.
reference_equations.baseline_persistence: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the persistence branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.
reference_equations.baseline_rbf: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.
reference_equations.baseline_residual_rbf: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

scope_limit: Two reserved yeast strain labels, eighteen later author-derived qPCR percentages, same experiment campaign with audit-exposed targets; no blind validation or nutrient mechanism identification.
calibration_note: p22 and p72 are own-replicate fractions (source percentages/100). Delta=t−72h, and s is early log-odds change per hour. Fractions are clipped to0.0001–0.9999 only for log-odds calculation; original targets are unchanged. The output is100 times logistic(log-odds), in percentage points.75h is a development-selected shape scale. This early/late conditional equation does not estimate an independently measured fitness coefficient.
timing_contract: Author cached spreadsheet percentage from same-row qPCR ratio is the target. No same-time Cp/ratio is a predictor. Use only own replicate22/72-hour percentages to forecast96h and later. Biological replicate pairing from Sample Name.
exposure_notice: All packaged targets are now exposed; future scoring is retrospective. Schema audit printed first13 spreadsheet rows before model construction, including several later percentages across all strains. Allocation is still metadata-only and no fit/selection uses reserved targets, but confirmation is audit-exposed retrospective evidence, not a fully blind independent confirmation.

uncertainty.reason: Shared conditions, sensor/system dependence or small numbers of reserved groups do not support precise population-level confidence. No row-bootstrap intervals.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Verify native anchors and prediction-time inputs. Author cached spreadsheet percentage from same-row qPCR ratio is the target. No same-time Cp/ratio is a predictor. Use only own replicate22/72-hour percentages to forecast96h and later. Biological replicate pairing from Sample Name.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check dimensional consistency and physically plausible signs/regimes; explain identifiability, confounding and why an association is not automatically causal.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
